## What it is

To illustrate gender inequities in NCAA athletics, I created a series of interactive graphics, leveraging the ggplot and plotly libraries in R.
My partner and I presented findings in verbal and written formats to increase awareness of gender disparities and dispel myths about women’s collegiate sports.

## What I did

- Compiled and cleaned NCAA Equity in Athletics Disclosure Act (EADA) data.
- Built a series of interactive visualizations showcasing our findings.
- Created an rpubs document showing inequities in collegiate sports across multiple facets.
